description: Comprehensive baseline question set for RAG system quality evaluation

questions.question: Summarize the core capabilities of this knowledge base system and provide examples of supported features.
What types of external sources can be ingested into the knowledge base?
How does the system handle queries for which no relevant information is found?
Does the system provide citations for the information it provides? If so, how are they presented?
What types of documents are supported for ingestion?
How does the system determine which information to retrieve for a given query?
What authentication methods are supported by the system?
Does the system support multi-turn conversations? If so, how is context maintained?
What metrics are used to evaluate the performance of the system?
How does the system handle errors during ingestion or retrieval?
How are embeddings stored and managed in the system?
How does the system chunk documents for better retrieval?
Can the system ingest data from external websites? If so, what limitations exist?
How can the quality of the system's answers be evaluated?
How can users manage and organize their knowledge bases?
What fallback mechanisms does the system use when it cannot provide a fully grounded answer?
How does the system track and trace the processing of queries and answers?
How is the LLM integrated into the system's workflow?
How does the system compare current performance against baseline metrics?
What security features are implemented to protect sensitive information?
How does the system handle sitemap ingestion and what level of depth is supported?
What types of feeds are supported for ingestion and how often are they refreshed?
How is the quality of answers assessed and what factors contribute to a high-quality answer?
Can users apply filters to control what information is retrieved for their queries?
What are document runs and how are they used in the system?
What API endpoints are available for interacting with the system programmatically?
What user roles are supported and what permissions do they have?
What embedding models are supported and how are they configured?
How does the system manage ingestion and processing queues?
What reporting capabilities does the system provide for evaluating performance?
